% portfolio.tex
% Visual companion to resume.tex — this is where photos, galleries, and
% project write-ups live. Content in latex/portfolio/sections/*.tex is
% AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build.py from data/*.yaml — never hand-edit
% those files directly; edit the YAML and rebuild.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage[margin=0.9in]{geometry}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{../shared/theme}              % colors/fonts, generated from data/theme.yaml
\usepackage{../shared/portfolio-macros}   % \projectOpen, \projectPhoto, \projectGallery, ...
\input{../shared/title.tex}               % \myName, \myEmail, etc. — generated from data/title.yaml

\graphicspath{{../../}}   % so "media/projects/x/cover.jpg" paths in the YAML resolve as-is

\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, urlcolor=blueprint500, linkcolor=blueprint500}
\pagecolor{white}

\titleformat{\section}{\displayfont\bfseries\Large\color{graphite900}}{}{0em}{}[{\color{blueprint500}\titlerule[1pt]}]
\titlespacing{\section}{0pt}{18pt}{10pt}

\begin{document}

% ---- cover / header ----
\begin{center}
  {\displayfont\bfseries\huge \myName}\\[4pt]
  {\Large\color{steel700} \myTagline}\\[8pt]
  \myLocation\ \textbar\ \myEmail\ \textbar\
  \href{\myGithub}{GitHub}\ \textbar\ \href{\myLinkedin}{LinkedIn}\ \textbar\
  \href{\myWebsite}{\myWebsite}
\end{center}

\vspace{1em}
{\color{blueprint500}\hrule height 1.2pt}
\vspace{1.5em}

\section*{Projects}
\input{sections/projects.tex}

\section*{Design Team Experience}
\input{sections/design-team.tex}

\section*{Internships}
\input{sections/internships.tex}

\end{document}
